title: CMA Fest 2026: Here’s How to Watch the Country Music TV Special Online for Free
summary: Country music fans can enjoy the epic three-hour primetime TV concert special on Thursday (June 25) — watch online without cable.
contentText:

Hosted by Riley Green and Lara Spencer , the 2026 CMA Fest presented by SoFi features some of the hottest recording artists in country music performing live throughout Nashville. Although the music festival took place in early June, it was edited into a three-hour TV special broadcast that airs on Thursday (June 25) on ABC .

How to Watch 2026 CMA Fest Live Online, At a Glance:

- Date: June 25

- Network: ABC

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Fubo , Hulu

Watch 2026 CMA Fest on DirecTV

Who’s Performing During 2026 CMA Fest?

There’s a number of performances by famous recording artists throughout CMA Fest, such as Jason Aldean, Ella Langley, Tim McGraw, Cody Johnson, Blake Shelton, Keith Urban, Lainey Wilson, Bailey Zimmerman and others. Check out a list of performers during the TV special here .

How to Watch the 2026 CMA Fest Online

CMA Fest airs on Thursday (June 25) at 8 p.m. ET/PT on ABC. It also streams the following day, Friday (June 26), on Hulu . If you don’t have cable, you can still watch live online for free with a free trial from DirecTV , Hulu + Live TV and Fubo .
